d.ko: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.
d.en: From the creators of Angel Beats! and CLANNAD, Key, comes their latest emotional, award-winning journey. Follow protagonist Takahara Hairi as he travels to the secluded island Torishirojima, where he rediscovers what it means to enjoy summer vacation.
d.zh:
「唯有那片炫目，始终未曾忘却。」
由创作出「CLANNAD」等名作的游戏品牌Key带来的一款文字冒险游戏。
「暑假」「与伙伴的盛夏回忆」「乡愁」
在远离尘嚣的小岛上，与伙伴共度夏日的时光，谈场盛夏的恋爱。
这是夏日的故事。
无法忘怀，也不能忘怀的夏日回忆。

rv.t: 서머 포켓츠의 확장판인 Reflection Blue가 스팀에도 출시되었기에, 현시점에서 굳이 일반판을 플레이할 이유는 없다고 생각합니다. 새로운 캐릭터와 시나리오, 추가 루트 등이 대폭 확장된 Reflection Blue 버전으로 플레이하시기를 적극적으로 권장합니다.
플레이는 작년 여름에 했고 리플렉션블루로해서 플탐은 안 남았지만 갑자기 평가를 남가고 싶어서 남기게되었습니다. 제 첫 미연시 게임이었고요 미연시라고 하기에는 좀 거리감이 있지만 Key특유의 그 감성이 정말 좋습니다. …
I haven’t gone through many vn so my take on the genre’s pretty limited, but Summer Pockets is easily top tier out of all I’ve played. …

An excellent novel and anime from my favorite studio, Key🎈. You can play the game and watch the anime—it's very engaging. This further enhances the immersion. All the characters have interesting personalities and are perfectly cast. …
Now that Reflection Blue is out on Steam, there's no reason to purchase this one. Search "Summer Pockets: Reflection Blue" (Not Blue Reflection, that's another unrelated game)
在某个夏天，初次来到这座岛时，或许只是因为某些原因暂时停留。整理遗物，逃离城市，寻找过去。但随着时间流逝，这座岛上的一切开始变得特别，每天重复的生活逐渐变成了无法替代的回忆。 …
